ledger.factor_arithmetic: 1101 requests / 801 turn rows = 1.374532; decomposition 1.000 turn + 0.0849 tool-followup + 0.2897 unmarked per turn row (68/801 and 232/801)
ledger.factor_conservatism: the four controlled longrun grids ran at exactly 1.000 request per turn (rows-longrun-c-2026-10-26.jsonl: 192 rows / 192 turns). The factor above 1 comes from agentic rows carrying tool follow-ups and unmarked rows. Pricing at 1.374532 is the conservative number measured today; a scripted cell prices 27% cheaper.

H1_n.text: n >= 60 required; a p95 at n=48 is refused, not caveated

reps.text: H1 needs reps >= 2 at N=48; a settled rep=1 makes H1 undecided by construction

H3_margin.text: 2 of the 12 declared checkpoints = 16.7 pp, fixed

H3_mcnemar.text: secondary veto only when b + c >= 6

H3_unadjudicable.text: either arm decidable below 8 of 12 -> no verdict

checkpoint_ids.text: 12 v6 ids; every row file on disk carries the 3 v2 ids, so no existing row file can adjudicate H3

wall_mode: All wall hours assume the adjudicating grid's frozen thinking=off policy (PARM-1 line 151). The 60 s/turn column is the harness --projected-turn-wall default. on/auto columns are descriptive only: a thinking-on run can never support H1.

schedules.corroboration: rows-longrun-c-2026-10-26.jsonl is exactly this shape: 192 rows / 192 turns / 1 request per turn

H1.reason: n=48, 48*0.05 = 2.4 < 3; PARM-1 line 37 refuses it by name, not with a caveat

H3.reason: the closest run used the v2 fixture with 3 checkpoint ids (cp.t12, cp.t24, cp.t46); the 2-of-12 denominator does not exist, and b+c <= 3 < 6 makes the McNemar veto unreachable by construction

discordant_pair_arithmetic.formula: paired items = 12 declared v6 checkpoints x reps; b+c >= 6 is the license threshold for the secondary veto (PARM-1 line 108)

reachable.B: only at a 50% checkpoint flip rate

discordant_pair_arithmetic.note: the fixed 2-of-12 margin does not pool across reps: it is stated on the 12-item denominator, so each rep is its own 12-item read; pooling 36 pairs widens the McNemar veto, not the margin

recommendation.why: the only schedule that yields n >= 60 usable timings per adjudicating arm with 84 exclusions of headroom, evaluates H2, and gives 36 paired checkpoints, while leaving 2,427 requests for a replication or a retry; the literal 60-turn A costs +198 requests and voids the frozen rule hash
stop_rule: stop if requests_remaining < requests_for_next_cell  (next cell = 4 arms x 48 turns = 192 turns = 264 requests at factor 1.374532)
stop if any turn wall_ms/1000 > 180  (--turn-wall-cap; the aborted turn is excluded, and if the arm then has < 60 usable timings H1 is reported refused with the estimator message verbatim)
stop if ATTACK or V-GATE-CHAIN reports a defect after the run starts  (halt at the next cell boundary, no further cells)
stop if after rep 1 H3 vetos (b+c >= 6 and exact two-sided p < 0.05 with C worse, or C loses more than 2 of 12 checkpoints) - abandon reps 2-3, saving 528 requests
stop if either arm's grade_v5 decidable < 8 of 12  (H3 unadjudicable per PARM-1 line 113; do not buy more reps for a quality-blind read)

operator_decision.question: run A* on the frozen 48-turn grid, or extend LR-01.v6.json to 60 turns and re-freeze PARM-1?
operator_decision.default: A* on the frozen grid (no re-freeze; keeps comparability with the 48-turn grids already on disk)
operator_decision.cost_of_the_alternative: +198 requests, +1.6 h at the 60 s policy, and the prior 48-turn grids become non-comparable

cannot_fund.independent_grids: 4 independent 4-arm x 48-turn x 3-rep grids fit exactly (4 x 792 = 3,168 requests, 51 left). A 5th grid (3,960) does not.
never_at_this_quota: a 20-rep-per-arm power grid at N=48 (3,840 turns = 5,278 requests; exceeds the remaining budget by 2,059)
a fifth independent adjudicating grid at 3 reps (needs 3,960; 3,219 remain)
a paired quantile test for H1 at ANY budget - analyze_stats.py carries no paired quantile test (PARM-1 lines 38-40); 3,219 requests cannot buy a test that does not exist, only narrower disjoint CIs
between-rep quality variance for any 1-rep schedule (B and C) - variance needs reps >= 2 by definition
any thinking-on H1 adjudication: wall at on/auto mean for A* is 30.5 h (p90 109.2 h), and PARM-1 line 151 excludes thinking-on grids from H1 regardless of spend

refusals: a 48-turn cell at the measured live p90 (427.7 s/turn) projects 20,529.6 s and exits 8 under --max-wall 3600; only a 60 s/turn projection (2,880 s) or an arm/rep-level --max-wall >= 20530 admits it
the 180 s cap is not a per-turn wall (PROJECTION.json defaults.turn_wall_cap_s is an abort cap); using it as a per-turn wall inflates A* to 28.8 h
